notion.name: Notion
notion.description: Read, search, and update Notion pages and databases

auth.instructions: Go to https://www.notion.so/my-integrations → New integration → Copy the Internal Integration Secret

github.name: GitHub
github.description: Manage repos, issues, PRs, and code on GitHub

auth.instructions: Go to https://github.com/settings/tokens → Generate new token (classic) → Select scopes: repo, read:user

google-calendar.name: Google Calendar
google-calendar.description: View, create, and manage Google Calendar events

auth.instructions: Follow the OAuth setup at https://console.cloud.google.com → Enable Calendar API → Download credentials.json. Paste the contents of the JSON file below.
